title: RayCo4D: Ray-Conditioned Continuous Motion Model for Monocular 4D Dynamic Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2610.28351v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reconstructing dynamic 3D scenes from monocular video requires inferring motion from noisy and intermittently visible observations. Long-range tracks provide valuable geometric constraints, but integrating their fragmented temporal coverage into shared, continuous motion remains challenging. We introduce \textbf{RayCo4D}, a ray-conditioned continuous motion model for monocular 4D reconstruction that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states. Each track is associated with a reference-time 3D query constrained to its camera ray, and its image and depth observations constrain shared latent motion nodes through local many-to-many associations. Each node maintains an $\mathrm{SE}(3)$ pose and body-frame velocity at sparse support times. translated_title: RayCo4D：面向单目4D动态重建的光线条件化连续运动模型
translated_abstract: 从单目视频中重建动态3D场景需要从噪声大且间歇可见的观测中推断运动。长程轨迹能够提供宝贵的几何约束，但如何将其碎片化的时间覆盖整合到共享的连续运动中仍然是一个挑战。我们提出了RayCo4D，一个用于单目4D重建的光线条件化连续运动模型，它显式地将视觉测量与潜在的3D运动状态分离开来。每条轨迹都与一个约束在其相机光线上的参考时刻3D查询相关联，其图像和深度观测通过局部多对多关联来约束共享的潜在运动节点。每个节点在稀疏支撑时刻维护一个SE(3)位姿和体坐标系速度。加速度白噪声过程先验将相邻状态耦合起来并定义了连续时间插值，使得跨越不同可见性区间的观测能够共同约束……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了RayCo4D，一个光线条件化的连续运动模型，通过将视觉测量与潜在3D运动状态分离，并利用长程轨迹的多对多局部关联约束共享的潜在运动节点，同时借助加速度白噪声过程先验实现连续时间运动插值，从而从单目视频中实现动态4D场景重建。
en_tdlr: RayCo4D is a ray-conditioned continuous motion model that explicitly separates visual measurements from latent 3D motion states, uses local many-to-many associations from long-range tracks to constrain shared latent motion nodes, and employs a white-noise-on-acceleration process prior for continuous-time interpolation, enabling monocular 4D dynamic scene reconstruction.
